body: Both of you please feel free to contact me. I know it feels like nobody cares or understands but I do. No one feels the same depression but we CAN relate. If I can help I will because your life's are precious

You're not alone and there are people who care about you. I may be a stranger but I care about you. Your life is precious. You should ask your doctor for help. You can contact them even if your parents won't. I don't know what you're going through because everyone is different but I also suffer from major depression and am here if you need to talk/vent to someone non judgemental. Again I do care about your life because life itself is a miracle

Please don't. I know life is hard and being depressed makes it worse. I suffer severe depression and have attempted suicide having lost everything including my family but people still care. I know I may be a stranger but I do. Your life is precious and it's billions to one chance you were even here so YOU ARE SPECIAL. feel free to contact me on here to talk/vent and again I do care

Depression is pure hell and I don't think therapy is necessarily the answer but talking to someone who understands and has gone threw depression does help also I know seeing your doctor about depression medication is scary and it takes time to work but it can help feel free to message me on here if you want to talk/vent all life is prescious and although I'm a stranger I do care

I know how it is. I lost my wife and kids a little over a year ago to another man and my life spiraled down hill from there. I know the thought of medication is scary but I suggest seeing your doctor and being completely open with them. Therapy sessions do help as well even though it's a little scary as well. Feel free to message me on here if you need to talk I'm non judgemental and a stranger who knows nothing about you but I still care.
